queries_used.note: Four parallel research tracks, each capped at 8 queries per source and ~15 min. Tier-1 (gh) and local-repo reads dominated; Tier-2 Context7 used only by the identity track; Tier-4 firecrawl used by the rebrand track (~4 calls). Budget was not exceeded; VSCodium/Ungoogled-Chromium pipelines were NOT verified (lowers confidence of cand-002).

candidates.name: Brand seam + build-profile stub swap (overlay pattern, Brave-style)

evidence.claim: Brave keeps upstream pristine; divergences live in patches/ + chromium_src overrides and a re-run string-rewrite script, with over-matching as the known failure mode.

risks: Full identifier rename (D-004 literal) is the worst case for merge cost; this pattern renames only the user/operator-visible surface and aliases the rest.
pnpm guard / AGENTS.md boundary rules may constrain bundler aliasing (unverified).
candidates.decision_rationale: Only strategy that satisfies both 'stay mergeable' and a user-visible full rebrand. Requires operator confirmation of the D-003/D-004 reconciliation.

candidates.name: git rerere + re-runnable idempotent codemod after each upstream merge

evidence.claim: rerere replays recorded conflict resolutions; helps only when the same hunk conflicts repeatedly.
VSCodium / Ungoogled-Chromium patch-and-substitute pipelines described from background knowledge only — NOT verified this session.

risks: Low confidence on VSCodium/Ungoogled evidence.
Codemod over-match (Brave's 'Google Lens -> Brave Lens' failure) needs an allowlist + verifier.

candidates.name: ast-grep / rg+sd codemod tooling

evidence.claim: Named by the rebrand track as candidate tooling; maintenance/licence NOT checked.

risks: Unverified maintenance and licence.
candidates.decision_rationale: Choose and verify at spec time; the codemod must be a TypeScript script per AGENTS.md (TS-first).

candidates.name: sso-broker guest-minter extension

evidence.claim: Verified in source: /exchange, /redeem, ES256 flint_session JWT cookie, Kratos-shaped /sessions/whoami (main.rs:341) already exist; no guest minting exists.
gate's anonymous provider (auth/mod.rs:89-108) yields one static subject — unusable for per-person identity.

risks: Open minting endpoint needs per-IP rate limit + challenge + GC.
Guest cookie is a bearer token.
gate multi-provider fallback per route is inferred, not read.
candidates.decision_rationale: Pattern exists; add /guest and /s/<token>, extend whoami with metadata_public.

candidates.name: flint-gate as the edge in front of the KnowDesign daemon

evidence.claim: Verified: strips client x-flint-* headers, injects X-Flint-User-Id/-Tenant-Id/-Principal-Type/-Scope, ratelimit module present; live in flint-core ns.

risks: No design.know-me.tools site/route exists yet.
Daemon must be reachable only via gate (NetworkPolicy).

candidates.name: Ory Kratos code (passwordless OTP) + passkey methods + admin recovery link/code

evidence.claim: Context7 /ory/docs: selfservice.methods.code.passwordless_enabled, passkey, admin POST /admin/identities and /admin/recovery/{code,link}.
Verified live config: v26.2.0, password only; identity schema change required to add code credentials.

risks: Identity-schema change affects existing identities — stage first.
recovery/link may be deprecated in favour of /code; verify on live v26.2.0.
Admin 'create session for identity' not confirmed.
candidates.decision_rationale: No native anonymous identity exists; Kratos fits externals, not the silent main user.

candidates.name: Keto relation tuples via FRF AuthzService for project#viewer/commenter/editor

evidence.claim: Verified: Check/WriteRelation/DeleteRelation on RelationTuple{tenant_id,subject,relation,object}.
Upstream roles are only owner|admin|member (collab.ts:18).

risks: Tuple expiry job needed for time-boxed validator access.
candidates.decision_rationale: Per-project scoped roles; server-side Check, never UI-only.

candidates.name: Upstream CollabCloudClient wire contract (collab-cloud.ts) backed by FRF Iggy + Forge
candidates.fit_for_gap: goal-2 keep team workspaces with zero upstream-file edits (comments + members)

evidence.claim: Verified: selected by env alone (OD_COLLAB_CLOUD_URL/TOKEN); GET/PUT /teams/:t/members, POST/GET comments with seq cursor + ETag. Maps to an Iggy stream.

risks: Covers comments + members only; presence, invites, resources, context remain on Vela paths.
OD_COLLAB_STORE does not exist — do not plan around it.
candidates.decision_rationale: Best zero-conflict seam, but only partial.

candidates.name: ResourcePublishAdapter / WorkspaceContextProvider / TeamProjectCatalogSink seams (collab runtime)

evidence.claim: Verified injectable via createCollabRuntime({adapter}); hardcoded === 'vela' checks at server.ts:3841,3904,3918,6072 and collab/sync-digest.ts:125 are conflict hotspots.

risks: WorkspaceCollabContext carries billing/seat fields; buildWorkspacePermissions locks writes on 'locked' lifecycle — must be stubbed to active BEFORE billing removal.
candidates.decision_rationale: Add collab/frf-*.ts files; extend only the three selector functions.

candidates.name: Vela-API-compatible gateway + vela CLI shim (alternative to cand-009)

evidence.claim: Inferred: keep OD_WORKSPACE_CONTEXT_SOURCE=vela and point VELA_API_URL at an FRF/Forge gateway speaking the /api/v1 subset; mocks are partial executable specs.

risks: Perpetuates 'vela' naming and a spawned CLI contract we would own forever.
Conflicts with removing Vela per D-002.
candidates.decision_rationale: Kept as a fallback if seam edits (cand-009) prove too conflict-prone; spike decides.

candidates.name: FRF Spine/Iggy for comment stream, notification inbox and audit events; Forge Quarry for read-state/catalog
candidates.fit_for_gap: goal-2 re-modeled message center, audit log

evidence.claim: Verified: SpineService Publish/Subscribe with offset resume; live in cluster. Message-center DTO (message-center-client.ts) is already generic.

risks: Per-member inbox topic design is inferred.
CLI dual-track rule: every new surface needs HTTP + web + od subcommand together.
candidates.decision_rationale: Matches existing infra; no new component.

candidates.name: agent-client-protocol Rust crate (official)

evidence.claim: Verified: openai-proxy/Cargo.toml uses agent-client-protocol = 1.2.0 with typed SessionNotification; schema constant is session/update. Versions 1.2.0–2.2.0 cached locally.

risks: Pick newest crate matching schema; keep protocolVersion 1 for open-design.
candidates.decision_rationale: Official, already building in the workspace.

candidates.name: openai-proxy src/acp.rs (prometheus-skill-pack) as wrapper skeleton

evidence.claim: Verified: wire-compliant (session/update) though docs/acp.md is stale ('v0.11', session/notification); implements only initialize, session/new, session/prompt with text chunks.

risks: Lacks cancel, load, tool_call, permission, set_model, model list.
candidates.decision_rationale: Skeleton only; ~80% of the wrapper is new.

candidates.name: letta-ai/letta-acp and zed-industries/codex-acp

evidence.claim: Exist per gh search (letta-acp is TS + @agentclientprotocol/sdk; codex-acp is Rust). Contents NOT read.

risks: Not read; mapping fidelity unknown.
candidates.decision_rationale: Read during spec for event/permission mapping ideas.

candidates.name: KnowMe CSS design tokens (desktop/src/index.css) + brand logo library

evidence.claim: Verified: Tailwind-4 @theme tokens, ember #FF6A3D/#E04E28, canvas #0B0F14, Inter/Space Grotesk/JetBrains Mono; logos at know-me/branding/logos; Tauri icon set exists (needs Electron icns/ico).

risks: No tokens.toml/DESIGN.md exists — create one derived from index.css.
'Flat 2.0' (no borders/dividers) may conflict with open-design component styles and CSS-module conventions.
Dart tokens drift (muted/faint/status) is resolved by D-005 in favour of CSS.

candidates.name: Yjs / Automerge / Loro / Hocuspocus (CRDT stack)

evidence.claim: Verified via GitHub API 2026-10-02: all actively maintained, MIT. Upstream collab is single-writer snapshot sync with no co-editing; presence-tracker states live cursors were cut.

risks: Revisit if multi-writer editing of one artifact becomes a requirement.
candidates.decision_rationale: Not needed for the current collaboration model; FRF SyncService can carry comment/member streams.

candidates.name: Novu (notifications)

evidence.claim: Active; licence mixed/unconfirmed (enterprise directories).

risks: Licence not confirmed.
candidates.decision_rationale: Resend is already available; Iggy inbox + Resend digest suffices.

build_required.need: Per-user identity keying across daemon tables/endpoints (owner on projects, runs, messages, conversations; trust X-Flint-* from gate only)
build_required.why_no_candidate: Daemon has no per-user primitive; estimated 1-2 weeks, estimate not based on reading daemon source.
No Kratos/gate/broker feature does per-device guests (verified).

build_required.need: External validator invite service (Kratos admin identity + recovery link/code + Keto tuple + expiry job)
build_required.why_no_candidate: Composition of existing parts; no packaged flow.

build_required.need: viewer/commenter roles + human review/approval decision record
build_required.why_no_candidate: Upstream roles are owner/admin/member; needs_review/resolved are agent-apply states.

build_required.need: uar acp stdio wrapper (cancel, load, tool_call, request_permission, set_model, model list, keepalive) + file-materialisation bridge
build_required.why_no_candidate: No generic ACP-over-OpenAI-HTTP bridge exists; UAR executes tools server-side and cannot write the daemon's cwd.
No dedicated storage API in forge; IPFS/MinIO exist in cluster but no app-facing API found.
Verified not deployed; k8s/base manifests exist but target a different cluster.
